auxiliary.input: live original [4,all TRAIN nodes,H] native preheads, then fixed selected TRAIN rows
auxiliary.alignment_positives: every other existing route/node record with same observed class, including same node in different route
auxiliary.alignment_negatives: existing records from other observed TRAIN classes; no augmentation/instance negatives
auxiliary.denominator: within-class mean exp similarity, then sum across observed classes before log
auxiliary.anchor_reduction: mean within observed anchor class, then mean over eligible classes
auxiliary.one_class: alignment zero; variance may remain active
auxiliary.singleton_class: cross-route same-node positives permitted, no distinct-node variance support
auxiliary.variance: class-mean normalized std floor across distinct nodes within each route/class; not across routes
auxiliary.selection: fixed once per fit, SHA256(seed,class,ID) order within class, round robin over sorted classes, return native source order
auxiliary.minimum_support: all source TRAIN classes retained and at least2nodes/class when available; fail if that minimum cannot fit512

update.native_F: complete original TRAIN CE mean per member then mean over4routes
update.gradient_scope: ordinary all-block scalar backward; auxiliary reaches only parameters upstream of captured preheads
update.final_output_bank_auxiliary_gradient: none directly; native CE remains active

old_method_preserved: boundary_own_within_route_supcon is a distinct whole-TRAIN within-route/unbalanced denominator objective; not renamed or claimed equivalent
